prīmānus , a, um, adj. primus,
I.of or belonging to the first legion: “primanus tribunus apud Catonem ...,” Fest. p. 235 Müll.; cf.: primanus tribunus erat, qui primae legioni tributum scribebat, Paul. ex Fest. p. 235 ib. (acc. to Mommsen: qui primam legionem tributim scribebat; v. Becker, Antiq. 3, 2, p. 131).—Subst.: prīmāni , ōrum, m., soldiers of the first legion, Tac. H. 2, 43; 4, 37.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
